turns.text: Hello there! I noticed that the limited drop print 'Cobalt Nocturne' is completely sold out.
Hi! Sorry you missed Cobalt Nocturne. Limited-drop prints aren’t restocked and can’t be reserved.

rule.ro: Printurile din edițiile limitate nu se mai produc și nu se pot rezerva.
rule.en: Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved.

turns.text: Will there be any restock of that limited drop in the future?
No, Cobalt Nocturne won’t be restocked. Limited-drop prints are never restocked and can’t be reserved.
On another note, fresh tattoo ink might cause allergic skin reactions. What ointment should I use for healing?
I can’t recommend an ointment for a fresh tattoo. Please see a doctor to check for a possible allergic reaction and advise you on what’s safe to use.
I can ask my doctor about the skin reaction.
Yes, your doctor is the right person to ask about the reaction and what’s safe to use.
Coming back to 'Cobalt Nocturne', that's the only edition I'm interested in.
I understand you’re only interested in Cobalt Nocturne. I’m sorry you missed it. Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved.
Could you reserve one copy for me if a spare print turns up?
Sorry, we can’t reserve a copy of Cobalt Nocturne, even if a spare turns up. Limited-drop prints can’t be reserved.
